Will fix I am running merge-devnet-3 with geth and lighthouse. All looks good apart from this repeating error.ERROR[12-15|08:34:56.160] Snapshot extension registration failed peer=968fed87 err="peer connected on snap without compatible eth support" Moving a discussion from <#692062809701482577> https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/692062809701482577/920365953232019456 <@!360491619402776577> <@!199561711278227457> may have valuable input on this tool as they are contributing a lot of efforts into Merge testing and devnets cc <@!316784424593129472> This is a known issue. It should be downgraded to a warning, but there's some additional complexity. Best to just ignore it. <@!316784424593129472> Your screenshots already look really useful to me. Would be great to also get info about the head blocks, (`eth.getBlock("latest")`) maybe bad blocks?, total difficulty, last pow block hash/ number of merge block yea that would be useful, especially when there are bad blocks. Also how many ELs and CLs can we connect to this? Is the idea that it represents info from 1 client or a bunch? fyi, i'd be taking down the 2 week's old devnet `merge-devnet-2` later today if there's no objection. I'll can get working on <@!360491619402776577> 's feedback. <@!199561711278227457> I can definitely add the ability to connect multiple clients. What are some things you'd like to see with regards to this? Would a view where you can see the current status & state of each client be useful? What values would you want for each EL and CL? excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content:
This is a known issue. Since a lot of projects are forking geth, they will rename the networking protocol `eth` to something else. 
If they connect to your node, we will reject them, because they have `snap` but not `eth` network protocols and throw this error.
It should be downgraded to a warning, but there's some additional complexity. Best to just ignore it.
